_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Occupational Safety and Health Plan
summary: Specifies the format and content for a contractor-prepared Occupational Safety and Health Plan describing the tasks and activities required to meet safety and health program requirements at the Combined Tactical Training Ranges.
use_relationship:
The Occupational Safety and Health Plan will provide the Government with description of the tasks and activities required to meet the Occupational Safety and Health Program requirements at the Combined Tactical Training Ranges (CTTR).

This data item description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendment and revision shall be as reflected in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The plan shall be in contractor format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The Occupational Safety and Health Plan shall include the following:

children.title: Documented process and description
children.content: Documented process and description to ensure continuing regulatory compliance with safety and health regulations.

children.title: Description of the closed loop corrective action
children.content: Description of the closed loop corrective action system approach to prevent reoccurrences.

preparation_instructions.title: The Plan shall include the training program
preparation_instructions.content: The Plan shall include the training program that will be implemented to ensure safety at the Combined Tactical Training Ranges (CTTR). The training program description shall include the following:

children.title: Occupational Health Standards in the Work Place
Vehicle Operations on the Ranges
children.content: (this includes Heavy Equipment, 4-wheel drive vehicles, ATV's on ordnance ranges)

children.title: Emergency Shower and Eye Wash Procedures
Combustible and Flammable Materials (Paints, Solvents, etc.)
Range Safety
children.content: (Ordnance safety, Unexploded Ordnance (UXO) safety, two man rule, etc.)
